title: Book Three · Chapter 161: What the First List Covers
story:
A month after the first twenty yuan, Mum and Dad check the household book again.

On Sunday afternoon, they put another twelve and eight into the study envelope. The parents now hold forty yuan for that purpose.

Ronan's own twenty-seven and twenty and a half are still separate. Together, the three envelopes hold eighty-seven and a half yuan.

He writes the new actual amount below the last one.

The centre's second reply arrived early in the new term. Today they put its food estimate beside the class and room fees.

The example food cost is about thirty yuan a month. Four months make about one hundred and twenty.

“An estimate,” Mum says. “People eat differently.”

Ronan writes that word beside the figure.

Classes are one hundred and eighty. The room is sixty. With the food estimate, the first term reaches three hundred and sixty.

On Friday, Ronan asked at the station about the coastal city. The present bus journey takes about eight hours. A one-way seat is twenty yuan.

He adds twenty to the first list.

“Three hundred and eighty,” he says.

Dad points to the room-supply answer.

“And these?”

The centre provides a bed, a table, and a chair in the shared room. Students bring their own bedding and personal things.

Ronan leaves those costs open. He still needs the local journey from the arrival station to the centre.

“So this isn't the whole first-term cost yet,” he says.

“And the year has a second term,” Mum adds.

He nods and writes First Term at the top. The other term needs its own plan later.

Dad reads the practice line once more. Those two weekly afternoons are unpaid. Ronan puts no future wages against the costs.

For a while, they look at the saved amount and the much larger list.

“We have time to keep asking,” Dad says. “We need the real application dates too.”

Mum puts the household book away. She has kept the money for work materials beside it.

Ronan thanks them and takes his own envelopes back to his shelf. The parents keep their forty with the household book.

Before dinner, he copies the unknown items onto one clean page. Then he carries the old drafts to the waste box.

Dad comes in with the bowls and looks at the cleared table.

“Space for dinner at last.”

Ronan smiles and puts the three chairs in place. Mum brings the vegetables, and he moves the last pencil away from her plate.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

estimate＝估计数；one-way＝单程的；bedding＝被褥等床上用品；purpose＝用途、目的。

## 理解问题

1. 本月第二次实际存钱后，父母信封与三份合计各是多少？未来钱是否提前算进来了？
2. 三百八十包含哪一段、哪些项目？哪些费用仍未知，是否覆盖全年两学期？

## 读句子

**Students bring their own bedding and personal things.**

拆开看：Students / bring / their own bedding and personal things.

学生们／自己带来／各自的被褥和个人用品。
